task_description: Write a method in Dafny to remove duplicate numbers from a given integer array.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method RemoveDuplicates(a: array<int>) returns (result: array<int>)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The result array contains no duplicate elements
- Every element in the result array appears in the input array
- The length of the result array is less than or equal to the length of the input array
- The order of the first occurrence of each element in the input array is preserved in the output array
code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.
In this case:
    method RemoveDuplicates(a: array<int>) returns (result: array<int>)
    
Step 2: Determine the preconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The input array should not be null
    
Dafny specification:
    requires a != null
    
Step 3: Determine the postconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The result array contains all distinct elements from the input array
    - The result array preserves the order of first occurrence of each element
    - The result array does not contain any duplicates

Dafny specification:
    ensures forall x :: x in result ==> InArray(a, x)
    ensures distinct(result)
    ensures |result| <= a.Length

predicate InArray(a: array<int>, x: int)
    reads a
{
    exists i :: 0 <= i < a.Length && a[i] == x
}

function distinct(seq: seq<int>): bool
{
    forall i, j :: 0 <= i < |seq| && 0 <= j < |seq| && i != j ==> seq[i] != seq[j]
}

Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.
In this case:

```dafny
method RemoveDuplicates(a: array<int>) returns (result: array<int>)
    requires a != null
    ensures forall x :: x in result ==> InArray(a, x)
    ensures distinct(result)
    ensures |result| <= a.Length
{
    var resSeq: seq<int> := [];
    var seen: set<int> := {};

    for i := 0 to a.Length
        invariant 0 <= i <= a.Length
        invariant forall x :: x in resSeq ==> InArray(a, x)
        invariant forall x :: x in resSeq ==> x in seen
        invariant distinct(resSeq)
    {
        if a[i] !in seen {
            resSeq := resSeq + [a[i]];
            seen := seen + {a[i]};
        }
    }
    result := resSeq.ToArray();
}
```
